Name: Brown Cows Give Chocolate Milk
Author: queermoth
Description:
Changes existing brown cows to produce chocolate milk instead of regular milk; that chocolate milk can then be placed in the cheese maker the same as regular milk, but it produces chocolate bars! There are also an additional four recipes added that use the produce added by this mod :)

Before reporting that brown cows aren't producing chocolate milk on existing saves, please try sleeping and milking again the next day! This will usually fix this. 

How to obtain recipes:
[spoiler]chocolate strawberry: buy at the saloon
hot chocolate: buy at the saloon
coconut macaroon: friendship 4 with sandy
hot-hot chocolate: winter 5[/spoiler]

Future Plans:
* Add recipe compatibility/new recipes
* Add option to change milk into a chance to be chocolate milk; would raise the prices of both chocolate milk and chocolate bars

Installation:
1. Install SMAPI & Content Patcher
2. Unpack file and drop it in your mods folder
3. Enjoy :>

Uses Content Patcher on SDV 1.6.
